title: Backwards on a tie
hints: Print the sort key for each team in the reproduction. The points and goal difference are equal, so what decides the order, and in which direction?
`reverse=True` reverses the comparison of the entire tuple, so the names end up Z to A as well. Only points and goal difference should be descending.
Drop `reverse=True` and negate the numeric parts instead: `key=lambda t: (-t.points, -t.goal_difference, t.name)`.
